Enum Class Mode2027Status

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Mode2027Status>
dev.tamboui.terminal.Mode2027Status
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Mode2027Status>, Constable
public enum Mode2027Status extends Enum<Mode2027Status>
Represents the status of Mode 2027 (grapheme cluster mode) support in a terminal.

Mode 2027 is a terminal feature that coordinates grapheme cluster handling between applications and terminals. When enabled, the terminal signals that it can handle complex grapheme clusters (ZWJ emoji sequences, regional indicators) as single display units.

  • Enum Constant Details

    • NOT_SUPPORTED

      public static final Mode2027Status NOT_SUPPORTED
      Terminal doesn't recognize Mode 2027. This typically means the terminal is older or doesn't support the DECRQM query for mode 2027.

    • SUPPORTED_DISABLED

      public static final Mode2027Status SUPPORTED_DISABLED
      Terminal recognizes Mode 2027 but has it disabled (Ps=2 or Ps=4 in DECRPM response).

    • ENABLED

      public static final Mode2027Status ENABLED
      Mode 2027 is currently enabled (Ps=1 or Ps=3 in DECRPM response).
